Looking at how renderers work in mistune, when a renderer function is called with `text` parameter, that `text` is typically the already-rendered children content (HTML).

For a block-level element like `block_spoiler`, it should wrap the rendered children in appropriate HTML tags. Following the pattern of `render_inline_spoiler` which uses `<span class="spoiler">`, the block version should use a block-level element like `<div class="spoiler">`.

Looking at typical mistune renderer patterns, block-level elements are wrapped with newlines and use `<div>` or similar block containers.
